id: title:Gilbert09:reject non latin 1 auth tokens at setup

review.posthog_relevance: Protects the warehouse ingestion connector against malformed authentication tokens, preventing potential 500 errors or request failures when users provide tokens with characters outside the latin-1 range.
review.reason: Adds a UnicodeEncodeError guard before constructing HTTP headers in the warehouse ingestion connector. This prevents a potential 500 error or request failure if a user provides an authentication token with characters outside the latin-1 range, returning a user-friendly error message instead.
review.uncertainty: While the production implementation is clear, the exact impact on production stability and the specific user benefit cannot be independently verified without runtime observation. The score is assigned based on the presence of a substantive, bounded correctness improvement, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.behavior: Adds a UnicodeEncodeError guard before constructing HTTP headers. The code attempts to encode the auth token using latin-1. If this fails, it returns an error immediately instead of letting the exception propagate and potentially cause a 500 error or request failure.
observations.posthog_connection: This protects the Sentry warehouse ingestion connector against malformed authentication tokens. The connector relies on the Authorization header, which the underlying HTTP client encodes as latin-1. If a user provides a token with characters outside this range, the request would fail.
